## Setup

This report follows `preregs/core2_prereg`. The pilot `.sav` contains the perception, trust, and solidarity items required for the individual-level governance tests. It does not contain the preregistered external governance indicators such as EQI or EQI change, so those models are included as optional hooks that activate if a context file is added.

```{r}
source("analysis_helpers.R")
load_analysis_packages()

input_file <- fs::path("data", "POLITSOLID_Pretest_interim_11032026.sav")
context_file <- "context/core2_context.csv"

analysis_data <- build_analysis_data(input_file)
analysis_data <- attach_optional_context(analysis_data, context_file)

has_context <- isTRUE(attr(analysis_data, "context_loaded"))

controls <- c(
  "age",
  "gender_binary",
  "factor(education_level)",
  "migrant_background",
  "factor(country)"
)

main_outcome <- "solidarity_territorial"

hypothesis_map <- tibble::tribble(
  ~hypothesis, ~status, ~proxy,
  "H1 Regional governance quality", if (has_context) "Will run if `regional_governance_quality` exists" else "Not testable from current pilot file", "Requires context file",
  "H2 Perceived governance quality", "Tested now", "perceived_governance_index, service_quality_index, institutional_trust_index",
  "H3 Attenuation after adding perceptions", if (has_context) "Will run if `regional_governance_quality` exists" else "Not testable from current pilot file", "Compare objective-context models with and without perceptions",
  "H4 Ideology moderation", "Tested now", "perceived_governance_index × ideology_right",
  "H5 Regional governance change", if (has_context) "Will run if `regional_governance_change` exists" else "Not testable from current pilot file", "Requires context file",
  "Additional prereg step: welfare-state moderation", if (has_context) "Will run if `welfare_state_size` exists" else "Not testable from current pilot file", "Optional context interaction"
)

predictor_labels <- tibble::tribble(
  ~term, ~term_label,
  "perceived_governance_index_z", "Perceived governance composite",
  "service_quality_index_z", "Service quality component",
  "institutional_trust_index_z", "Institutional trust component",
  "ideology_right_z", "Right ideology",
  "perceived_governance_index_z:ideology_right_z", "Governance × ideology",
  "regional_governance_quality_z", "Regional governance quality",
  "regional_governance_change_z", "Regional governance change",
  "welfare_state_size_z", "Welfare-state size",
  "regional_governance_quality_z:welfare_state_size_z", "Governance × welfare-state size"
)
```

```{r}
hypothesis_map %>%
  render_table(digits = 2)
```

## Visual Checks

```{r}
visual_data <- analysis_data %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    solidarity_territorial,
    `Perceived governance composite` = perceived_governance_index,
    `Service quality component` = service_quality_index,
    `Institutional trust component` = institutional_trust_index
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -solidarity_territorial,
    names_to = "measure",
    values_to = "predictor"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(solidarity_territorial), !is.na(predictor)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(measure) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(bin = dplyr::ntile(predictor, 5)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(measure, bin) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    predictor_mean = mean(predictor, na.rm = TRUE),
    solidarity_mean = mean(solidarity_territorial, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(visual_data, aes(x = predictor_mean, y = solidarity_mean)) +
  geom_line(color = "#386641", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n), color = "#bc6c25") +
  facet_wrap(~ measure, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1.5, 4), guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "Descriptive association between governance perceptions and solidarity",
    x = "Predictor value",
    y = "Mean territorial solidarity"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

## OLS Models for H2 and H4

```{r}
h2_predictors <- c("perceived_governance_index_z")
h2_components <- c("service_quality_index_z", "institutional_trust_index_z")
h4_predictors <- c("perceived_governance_index_z", "ideology_right_z", "perceived_governance_index_z:ideology_right_z")

h2_data <- model_sample(analysis_data, main_outcome, c(h2_predictors, controls))
h2_components_data <- model_sample(analysis_data, main_outcome, c(h2_components, controls))
h4_data <- model_sample(
  analysis_data %>% dplyr::mutate(`perceived_governance_index_z:ideology_right_z` = perceived_governance_index_z * ideology_right_z),
  main_outcome,
  c("perceived_governance_index_z", "ideology_right_z", "perceived_governance_index_z:ideology_right_z", controls)
)

model_h2 <- fit_ols(h2_data, build_formula(main_outcome, h2_predictors, controls))
model_h2_components <- fit_ols(h2_components_data, build_formula(main_outcome, h2_components, controls))
model_h4 <- fit_ols(h4_data, build_formula(main_outcome, h4_predictors, controls))

ols_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  robust_tidy_lm(model_h2) %>% dplyr::mutate(model = "H2 composite"),
  robust_tidy_lm(model_h2_components) %>% dplyr::mutate(model = "H2 components"),
  robust_tidy_lm(model_h4) %>% dplyr::mutate(model = "H4 moderation")
) %>%
  coef_plot_data(label_map = predictor_labels, keep_terms = predictor_labels$term) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(model = factor(model, levels = c("H2 composite", "H2 components", "H4 moderation")))

ols_results %>%
  dplyr::select(model, term_label, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(model, dplyr::desc(estimate)) %>%
  render_table(digits = 3)
```

```{r}
ggplot(ols_results, aes(x = estimate, y = forcats::fct_rev(term_label), xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high, color = model)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
  geom_errorbarh(height = 0.15, position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Governance models with robust OLS standard errors",
    x = "Coefficient estimate",
    y = NULL,
    color = "Model"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

## Interaction Plot for H4

```{r}
mode_country <- analysis_data %>%
  dplyr::count(country, sort = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1) %>%
  dplyr::pull(country)

mode_education <- analysis_data %>%
  dplyr::count(education_level, sort = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1) %>%
  dplyr::pull(education_level)

prediction_grid <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  perceived_governance_index_z = seq(-2, 2, length.out = 60),
  ideology_right_z = c(-1, 0, 1)
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    `perceived_governance_index_z:ideology_right_z` = perceived_governance_index_z * ideology_right_z,
    age = mean(analysis_data$age, na.rm = TRUE),
    gender_binary = 0,
    education_level = mode_education,
    migrant_background = 0,
    country = mode_country,
    ideology_group = dplyr::case_when(
      ideology_right_z == -1 ~ "Left-leaning",
      ideology_right_z == 0 ~ "Center",
      TRUE ~ "Right-leaning"
    ),
    predicted = stats::predict(model_h4, newdata = ., type = "response")
  )

ggplot(prediction_grid, aes(x = perceived_governance_index_z, y = predicted, color = ideology_group)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Predicted solidarity by governance perception and ideology",
    subtitle = "Predictions from the H4 interaction model, holding controls constant",
    x = "Perceived governance index (z)",
    y = "Predicted territorial solidarity",
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

## Ordered Logit Robustness

```{r}
ordered_outcomes <- c("plsolmuni", "plsolcntry", "plsoleu")
ordered_terms <- c("perceived_governance_index_z", "ideology_right_z", "perceived_governance_index_z:ideology_right_z")

ordered_results <- purrr::map_dfr(
  ordered_outcomes,
  function(outcome_name) {
    ordered_data <- model_sample(
      analysis_data %>% dplyr::mutate(`perceived_governance_index_z:ideology_right_z` = perceived_governance_index_z * ideology_right_z),
      outcome_name,
      c(ordered_terms, controls)
    )
    ordered_model <- fit_ordered(ordered_data, build_formula(outcome_name, ordered_terms, controls))

    ordered_tidy(ordered_model) %>%
      coef_plot_data(label_map = predictor_labels, keep_terms = ordered_terms) %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        outcome = outcome_name,
        term_label,
        estimate,
        conf.low,
        conf.high,
        p.value
      )
  }
)

ordered_results %>%
  dplyr::arrange(outcome, dplyr::desc(estimate)) %>%
  render_table(digits = 3)
```

## Optional Objective-Context Models

Expected columns in `context/core2_context.csv`:

- `country`
- `region`
- `regional_governance_quality`
- `regional_governance_change`
- `welfare_state_size` if you want the extra welfare interaction

```{r}
if (has_context && "regional_governance_quality" %in% names(analysis_data)) {
  has_change <- "regional_governance_change" %in% names(analysis_data)
  has_welfare <- "welfare_state_size" %in% names(analysis_data)

  context_data <- analysis_data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      regional_governance_quality_z = standardize(regional_governance_quality),
      regional_governance_change_z = if (has_change) standardize(regional_governance_change) else NA_real_,
      welfare_state_size_z = if (has_welfare) standardize(welfare_state_size) else NA_real_
    )

  context_only_data <- model_sample(context_data, main_outcome, c("regional_governance_quality_z", controls))
  model_context_only <- fit_ols(context_only_data, build_formula(main_outcome, "regional_governance_quality_z", controls))

  context_plus_data <- model_sample(context_data, main_outcome, c("regional_governance_quality_z", "perceived_governance_index_z", controls))
  model_context_plus <- fit_ols(context_plus_data, build_formula(main_outcome, c("regional_governance_quality_z", "perceived_governance_index_z"), controls))

  attenuation_table <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    robust_tidy_lm(model_context_only) %>% dplyr::mutate(model = "Objective governance only"),
    robust_tidy_lm(model_context_plus) %>% dplyr::mutate(model = "Objective governance + perceptions")
  ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(term == "regional_governance_quality_z") %>%
    dplyr::select(model, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value)

  attenuation_table %>%
    render_table(digits = 3)

  if (has_change) {
    change_data <- model_sample(context_data, main_outcome, c("regional_governance_quality_z", "regional_governance_change_z", controls))
    model_change <- fit_ols(change_data, build_formula(main_outcome, c("regional_governance_quality_z", "regional_governance_change_z"), controls))

    robust_tidy_lm(model_change) %>%
      coef_plot_data(label_map = predictor_labels, keep_terms = c("regional_governance_quality_z", "regional_governance_change_z")) %>%
      dplyr::select(term_label, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value) %>%
      render_table(digits = 3)
  }

  if (has_welfare) {
    welfare_data <- model_sample(
      context_data %>% dplyr::mutate(`regional_governance_quality_z:welfare_state_size_z` = regional_governance_quality_z * welfare_state_size_z),
      main_outcome,
      c("regional_governance_quality_z", "welfare_state_size_z", "regional_governance_quality_z:welfare_state_size_z", controls)
    )
    model_welfare <- fit_ols(
      welfare_data,
      build_formula(
        main_outcome,
        c("regional_governance_quality_z", "welfare_state_size_z", "regional_governance_quality_z:welfare_state_size_z"),
        controls
      )
    )

    robust_tidy_lm(model_welfare) %>%
      coef_plot_data(
        label_map = predictor_labels,
        keep_terms = c("regional_governance_quality_z", "welfare_state_size_z", "regional_governance_quality_z:welfare_state_size_z")
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(term_label, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value) %>%
      render_table(digits = 3)
  }
} else {
  tibble::tibble(
    note = "Objective governance models were not run. Add context/core2_context.csv with country, region, and regional governance variables to activate H1, H3, H5, and the optional welfare interaction."
  ) %>%
    render_table(digits = 2)
}
```

## Notes

- The preregistration text uses inconsistent numbering between the hypothesis list and the later analysis steps. This report follows the main hypothesis numbering H1-H5 and then treats welfare-state moderation as an additional preregistered analysis step when context data are available.
- The current pilot file does not include the external governance indicators or weights mentioned in the preregistration, so those analyses are either skipped or run only if a context file is provided.
- The results here are best used as pilot checks of directional coherence and measurement behavior.
